summary: Measure owner-host agent mail input acceptance with a durable 30-day native error budget

replay.detail: Graph sends and local lifecycle marks backfill retained mail metadata; messages-shard mirror lifecycle evidence replays with a dedicated cursor and original source timestamps. Native acceptance certificates replay their original driver timestamps and recipient incarnations. Historical generic delivered/read assertions do not manufacture native acceptance.

schema.detail: Adds local_mail_input_acceptance_v1, local_mail_acceptance_frontier_v1, local_mail_delivery_source_v1 and local_mail_delivery_steps_v1, plus rebuildable local_mail_delivery_pending_v1 and a send-time index. These member-local metadata ledgers retain source identity/timestamps and sender/tags, not message content. Original send-clock validity survives legacy mirror fallbacks. Audit metadata currently has no automatic deletion; 30d bounds evaluation, not storage. Transactional pending-key projection and indexed current-window queries keep event-driven capture independent of completed audit-history size; lifecycle/certificate reads use only relevant message key ranges.

rules.detail: agents/mail-delivery/<host> requires 95% of eligible durable agent messages to reach confirmed harness input acceptance within 15m of the ORIGINAL durable send over 30d. Open overdue messages fail once at their original deadline; terminal undelivered close/expiry is bad. Explicit next-turn holds remain visible until eligibility, without resetting or subtracting elapsed hold time after release. Native paired burns are 14.4x for 1h+5m or 6x for 6h+30m. Accounting stops at the minimum proven current native producer frontier, never a daemon heartbeat.

compatibility.detail: Adds accepted lifecycle receipts with input_acceptance.accepted_at_unix_ms on the existing owner-fenced mailbox receipt endpoint and POST /v1/mailbox/acceptance-frontier with a flat native fence and observed_through_unix_ms. Neither advances ordinary delivered/read state. Missing ownership, uncertified historical delivery, source capture failure, incomplete shard coverage, malformed clocks, startup and missing/stale native frontiers remain unknown and cannot recover owner episodes. Native frontier freshness is 120s; daemon capture heartbeat cannot renew that proof.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; source replay runs before native mail coverage is admitted.

manual.detail: Fleet-owned native objective declarations can bind agents/mail-delivery/<host> to their accountable delivery owner. Public defaults contain no private fleet owners or host inventory.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback preserves the new local metadata tables but older binaries do not publish native acceptance certificates. After re-upgrade, uncertified delivered/read history stays unknown instead of being converted to success; open and terminal source metadata replays idempotently.
